title: Make the context proxy env test pass under parallel-lane load
body:
Outcome: `test/claude/ctx-proxy-env.test.ts` passes 20 of 20 runs on this host under parallel-lane load (load average above 40).
Why: lane launcher-marker (t-bs1ytt2) measured 4 failures in 10 runs on clean main at load ~44: the launcher-with-proxy test and "a healthy proxy yields its base URL" time out on a 300 ms health deadline; a flaky local test sends lanes to CI blind.
Proof: a loop of 20 runs under load prints 20 passes; the deadline is derived from the probe, not a guess.
Scope: test/claude/ctx-proxy-env.test.ts and the health probe it drives.
